name: B10-0160/2024 (The Left) – EU actions against the Russian shadow fleets and ensuring a full enforcement of sanctions against Russia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on EU actions against the Russian shadow fleets and ensuring a full enforcement of sanctions against Russia
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for tougher action against Russia's "shadow fleet" — old, often uninsured tankers used to dodge sanctions on Russian oil. It asks member states to block unsafe ships from their waters and ports, inspect tankers, seize illegal cargo and put the money into a fund for cleaning up oil spills. It also calls for more diplomacy to end the war, more renewable energy, and sanctions on Israel over its actions in Palestine.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet — this is the Parliament's request to the Commission and member states, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, ports, shipping, insurers and companies trading with Russia.
- **What happens next:** The Commission and member states decide whether to act on these requests.
